name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Ford's budget is exactly $10k more than the engineer with the Multimeter.
The Civil engineer's budget is between Hertz and the engineer on the Reactor.
$42k goes with exactly two of Otis, Structural, and Oscilloscope.
The Chemical engineer's budget is immediately next to the engineer on the Bridge.
The engineer on the Skyscraper's budget is lower than both Ford and the engineer with the Wrench.
The engineer on the Bridge's budget is between Hertz and the engineer with the Oscilloscope.
The engineer with the Welder's budget is exactly $10k more than the engineer on the Bridge.
